disclosureRules: Initial declaration is public. Release only current turn files and message.
Advance after agent response or a focused relevant request; equivalent question wording is allowed.
If asked about unavailable facts say I do not know; never invent files, waivers, signatures or authority.
If an earlier turn question is repeated, repeat the same answer and record unnecessaryQuestion.
Do not reveal oracle, expected states, internal modes, future files or complete catalog.
At each upload or reply capture an agent checkpoint. Tool order and wording are unconstrained.
After final turn no additional files exist. A lender or operator obligation remains unresolved.
